question: IRNSS - IG is the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**seventh navigation satellite**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IRNSS - IG** is the **seventh navigation satellite** in the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (IRNSS) series.
 
• The IRNSS is an autonomous satellite navigation system developed by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• The system is designed to provide accurate position information services to users in India and the surrounding region extending up to 1,500 km.
 
• It is intended to provide two types of services, namely Standard Positioning Service (SPS) for civilian use and Restricted Service (RS) for authorized users.
 
• IRNSS - IG was launched to complete the constellation of seven satellites in the IRNSS series, ensuring full operational capability of the navigation system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IRNSS** is also known as **NavIC** (Navigation with Indian Constellation).
 
• The first satellite in the IRNSS series, IRNSS-1A, was launched on 1st July 2013.
 
• IRNSS provides accurate position information to users in India and the region extending up to 1,500 km from its boundary, which is its primary service area.
 
• The system provides position accuracy better than 20 meters in the primary service area.
 
• IRNSS is designed to provide accurate position information to users in India and the surrounding region, which is beneficial for terrestrial, aerial, and marine navigation.
